title: Size each feature as max(WMBT-count size, footprint size)

facts.note: Planner artifacts (features, wagons, WMBTs) are identifiable by path/file kind.
Feature/WMBT plan files can be matched by path glob and file kind. This alone activates the rule for any feature sizing, including XS/S features and Pass 1 before any footprint exists.
Selects which pass applies; needs an observer that knows whether WMBT decomposition is complete and a footprint has been computed. Not a prerequisite for activation.

values: feature final size M or L
facts.note: OPTIONAL violation trigger only, not an activation prerequisite: compliant features and Pass 1 sizing activate the rule without any finding. Requires a detector that counts WMBTs per feature and computes footprint.

fires: A planner authors or edits a feature and assigns it a size from its WMBT count (Pass 1), even when the size is XS or S and no footprint exists yet.
After WMBT decomposition, a feature's footprint is computed and its final size must be reclassified (Pass 2), whether or not the result is compliant.
A feature has 11+ WMBTs or exceeds 8 components, 3 events, or 3 new events, and is about to be scheduled for execution.
A plan or doc edit states, restates or changes a feature's size or its execution eligibility, even if WMBT/component/event counts are unchanged.
doesNotFire: Editing code or tests that do not define, size or schedule a planner feature.
Editing a feature's prose in a way that neither defines, changes nor restates its size or execution eligibility, and does not change its WMBTs, components or events.
Sizing a wagon or train as a whole rather than an individual feature.

given: A feature has a WMBT count and, after decomposition, a footprint (components, events, new events).
when: You size or reclassify the feature.
then: Set the feature's final size to max(WMBT-count size, footprint size).
prefer: Pass 1 (planning): size by WMBT count only, to unblock decomposition — XS ≤5, S 6–10, M 11–20, L >20.
Pass 2 (post-decomposition): compute the footprint, reclassify with the max rule, and gate M/L features.
Keep final size at S or smaller; split or stage any larger feature before execution — decompose/stage an M feature (11–20 WMBTs), split an L feature (>20 WMBTs) immediately.
Keep each feature within ≤8 components, ≤3 events, ≤3 new events.
avoid: Taking the smaller of the two sizes or using only the WMBT count once a footprint exists.
Sending an M or L feature to execution without splitting or staging it.
Shaving WMBT counts or merging events/components on paper to land in S without actually reducing scope.
why: Blended strategy: WMBT count alone sizes the feature early so decomposition is unblocked (Pass 1); once the footprint is known, the max rule reclassifies the feature so the larger of the two sizes governs and M/L features are gated (Pass 2).
evidence: Each feature records its WMBT-count size, its footprint size, and a final size equal to the larger of the two.
No feature with final size M or L enters execution; each was split or staged first.
Per-feature component, event and new-event counts are at or below 8, 3 and 3.
verifier_detail: final_size_rule: final = max(wmbt_count_size, footprint_size); size order XS < S < M < L; max_size = S.
wmbt_bracket: XS ≤5 WMBTs; S 6–10; M 11–20 (decompose/stage); L >20 (split immediately).
Per-feature footprint limits: max_components = 8, max_events = 3, max_new_events = 3.
overflow_action: split or stage before execution; fail any feature whose final size > S at the execution gate.
Footprint size is computed per planner.feature.footprint-scoring; WMBT count comes from planner.feature.grouping-strategy.

Original name: 'Feature size is the max rule'
Original statement combined two obligations: 'Final feature size = max(WMBT-count size, Footprint size); features MUST be S or smaller, else split or stage before execution.'

splitSuggestion.then: Do not send a feature whose final size exceeds S (i.e. M or L) to execution; split or stage it first (M: decompose/stage, L: split immediately), keeping ≤8 components, ≤3 events, ≤3 new events per feature.

additions.text: The source statement holds two obligations: (1) compute final size as max(WMBT-count size, footprint size) — kept in then; (2) cap final size at S and split/stage before execution — kept here in prefer[2]/avoid[1]/evidence/verifier_detail and proposed as separate convention planner.feature.size-cap-gate.
additions.justification: One-obligation rule for then; both requirements and traces are preserved.

additions.text: Rephrasing of 'Blended strategy' plus the Pass 1/Pass 2 text as the rationale ('so the larger of the two sizes governs').
additions.justification: Source gives no separate rationale; the why restates only source-authored content (S008–S010, S017) without new empirical claims.

additions.text: Shaving WMBT counts or merging events/components on paper to land in S without actually reducing scope; taking the smaller size or only WMBT count once a footprint exists.
additions.justification: Metric-gaming / misapplication anti-patterns required by the authoring rules; they follow from the max rule without adding an obligation.

additions.text: Each feature records its WMBT-count size, footprint size and final size.
additions.justification: Gives reviewers a way to check the max rule; the source states the rule but not how compliance is shown.
